first answer plus exact arbitrarily-long silent prefixes; every finite suffix stays open and fabricated exhaustion is impossible

finite local Goal states have only left-child progress; RawStep, public Transition, and every fixed-length trajectory are deterministic down to exact ordered events and successor state; calls splice one clause body before the retained cursor, while executable adequacy remains separate
a deliberately wrong right-first rule exposes the right answer before reducing the live left goal, while the certified relation proves that exact transition impossible

both the generic control layer and local Goal machine preserve scope discipline; public transitions and finite prefixes preserve the distinguished root boundary, the clause-body/cursor splice is well-scoped at predicate scope, and any reachable commit is caught at its active scope
Goal specialization must produce well-scoped processes with fresh opaque boundaries
answer-at-a-time product deterministically feeds each cumulative substitution into the raw caller tail and retains later head answers at caller scope; executable conjunction adequacy remains open
cut delimiter has its own nominal type and cannot be supplied as an exception-handler or answer-collection identity

cut, exception-handler, and answer-collection regions use different identifier types and structural nodes; smart constructors pair catch/findall-style regions with independent cut barriers and WellScoped subject reduction covers both nodes
matching-scope alternative is pruned before later answer or effect
well-scoped inner commit prunes its inner sibling but preserves and later observes the enclosing sibling
cut and exception unwinding sequentially prune discarded live cursors and expose ordered prune observations
raw scope discrimination on intentionally ill-scoped input; global-prune target underivable, not a compiled-reachability claim
call/1 and control-construct transparency table not specialized
demand-driven first-answer commit rule not yet added
condition-commit scope and branch ordering not yet added

typed collector consumes one answer at a time without exposing it, preserves duplicate-sensitive arrival order, suppresses only nested completion, retains effect/cut progress, catches its own cut before any outer choice, and is transparent to exceptions

local finite-tree findall allocates distinct cut and collection delimiters, consumes generator answers privately, materializes and injectively copies each template above the global fresh high-water, retains exact order and multiplicity, emits one bag only after exhaustion, propagates exceptions without a partial bag, and admits a source-shaped answer-then-left-recursion witness with arbitrarily long open prefixes

generic and local demand-driven generator traversal is proved, including copied-template projection, exact two-answer bag order/multiplicity, exception transparency, and a generator-success-then-divergence prefix with no partial bag; compiler/executable refinement, rational-tree and attributed-variable copying, local effects, and imported-SWI conformance remain open
typed handler consumes only a selected raised marker, preserves cursor-prune cleanup, lets unmatched exceptions escape, propagates cut to its independent cut barrier, and preserves WellScoped

finite-tree local control carries a copied ball plus throw-time bindings internally, performs SWI pre-unwind catcher selection before reconstructing recovery from saved entry bindings, erases the internal evidence only at the public terminal boundary, preserves cleanup and exact mismatch, and proves anti-entry-only and cut-scope counterexamples

primitive unification, clause entry, local calls, products, nested catch, public transitions, and every finite prefix preserve cumulative substitutions; copied-ball stability plus lineage makes successful pre-unwind selection constructively recoverable after unwind, the selection/mismatch split cannot get stuck, and an explicit aliasing counterexample proves ball stability is independently necessary

local throw/1 materializes under the throw-time bindings, injectively alpha-copies every finite-term variable into a globally fresh interval, preserves sharing and separation, cannot be captured by old substitution domains or values, discards the residual conjunction, and has exact uncaught and caught finite traces; four concrete anti-vacuity witnesses reject copy-before-materialization, alias loss, variable collapse, and value-hidden high-water collision

generic and independent finite-tree local control, throw copying, conditional catch progress, and one exact ground catch(throw/1) trace are proved; rational-tree and attributed-variable behavior, other exception producers, compiler/executable catch refinement, and imported-SWI conformance remain open
actual protocol tokens freeze ordered call-start visibility; old/new assertion and retraction witnesses plus a wrong-live-view step discriminate drift, and nested calls take their own generation
ordered dynamic updates and visibility generations open
commit/rollback, exception, and nested transaction behavior open
open/pull/prune/perform thread explicit Session state; imported-provider functionality, replay, and cursor-ownership conformance remain open
local opening is unique, returns a well-formed eagerly reserved cursor, and every pull is total and deterministic; match/reject/exhaust are disjoint
local pulls return entered-clause tags only; answer-free splice, ordered two-clause answers, and clause-one cut pruning are proved in certified control

local cursor identity is the fresh predicate-activation scope rather than snapshot equality; initialized public states forbid duplicate and future identities, preserve ownership through every finite prefix, remove every reported prune, cannot resurrect old identities, and report each activation pruned at most once; explicit duplicate/future-forgery counterexamples are rejected while equal snapshots at distinct scopes remain legal

generic imported providers prune discarded siblings sequentially, but their stateful protocol conformance must still prove token issuance, exclusive ownership, no reuse after pull, and prune-once preservation

every state and action threads explicit Session state; a generic monotone-measure theorem and its local fresh-high-water instance rule out rollback through backtracking, cut, or exception unwind; imported-provider replay conformance remains separate
eager call-start reservation preserves duplicate occurrences and exact source order while each pull exposes at most one standardized clause

all actual renaming targets lie in disjoint reserved intervals above the live query, nested targets begin above every retained outer target, and raw control steps cannot roll the high-water back; a concrete lazy-cursor foil collides
finite-tree occurs check, ordered Robinson derivation, most-generality, completeness, determinism, exact typed reification, and head-resolution uniqueness proved
executable substitution orientation and exact canonical-MGU refinement remain open
executable equality must use Float.toBits rather than IEEE equality; NaN identity must be reconciled explicitly with pinned SWI

a concrete local clause loop :- loop has exact arbitrarily long positive finite prefixes containing only call-open observations, with the machine still running and no fabricated answer, effect, exception, or completion

measure-free finite states deterministically execute truth, failure, ordered MGU, identity, conjunction, disjunction, cut, and recursive local calls; every pulled raw body is tied to its cumulative instantiation without an idempotence premise, bodies run left of retained clauses, products stream into caller tails, and concrete left recursion has exact open finite prefixes; remaining Goal constructors and executable refinement remain open
exact typed trace is trusted and replay-policed; SWI implementation is never counted as certified core
worker exposes findall only as a blocking completed-bag response and therefore cannot expose finite pre-exhaustion generator prefixes or demand-time pruning
terminating trace-to-list projection theorem open; list semantics may not be primary equivalence

current sealed findall is an atomic terminating-subrun macro and has no entry or nonterminal generator-prefix state, while the independent semantics proves source-shaped arbitrarily long open prefixes; exact divergence-sensitive bisimulation requires the fine-grained executable lane rather than stuttering or answer-list equivalence

internal sealed-to-fine fidelity only: the additive lane structurally keeps world and global high-water outside typed backtrackable frames, transfers rather than duplicates alternatives, forces findall entry, counts every private generator answer as one suppressed step, preserves inner world/high-water on exit, and expands terminating flat collectors into entry plus every inner step plus exit; native adequacy is explicitly excluded by BISIM.findall_copy

internal sealed-to-fine fidelity only: a terminating flat fine-grained collector collapses to the exact existing sealed atomic findall step, preserving the inner world and fresh high-water, duplicate-sensitive bag order, and every suspended outer-control field; native adequacy is explicitly excluded by BISIM.findall_copy

one bracketed inductive run handles arbitrarily nested terminating collectors: ordinary steps remain one-to-one, every collector contributes exactly entry plus recursively expanded inner steps plus exit, and erasure yields the sealed StepStar with the exact world, high-water, answer order, and continuation; a concrete empty generator is exactly three fine steps but one sealed step, while every still-open unpaired prefix is structurally excluded from macro collapse

a typed prefix zipper parses every arbitrary top-level fine StepsN derivation into either a closed MacroStepsN or explicit unpaired collector frames; returning to the empty stack forces the closed case with identical count and endpoints, giving an exact iff and sealed StepStar collapse without determinism, stuttering, or answer-list quotient assumptions

independent semantics and pinned SWI copy every residual template per solution, while the sealed and executable collector reuse the original source variable; Lean proves a reachable two-answer bag has duplicate source identity, the differential is native ($v1 $v2) versus PLeaTTa ($v1 $v1), and the dual characterization guards sharing within one solution

the state bridge projects the independent versioned logical-update history to the executable live clause list in exact order and multiplicity, preserves that projection through matching asserta/assertz updates and reindexing, and proves cut/exception/collection allocators are distinct typed ghost identities whose allocation leaves executable persistent state unchanged; cursor snapshots and ordinary-step correspondence remain separate

retract-side preservation of the current live database projection and the separate relation showing that already-open prepared cursors retain their call-start clause snapshots while later calls observe the advanced generation remain open; the state-store PASS covers asserta/assertz only and is not a full logical-update-view theorem

one actual independent clause copy and one actual executable suffix copy are reconciled by an explicit positional finite alpha graph over the exact clause support: both graph projections are exhaustive and duplicate-free, independent substitution sources/targets are exact, executable nested head/body occurrences and support are transported exactly, and the exact output-last head payload is structurally alpha-related through the two actual copiers; the counter currencies remain distinct, encoding injectivity is explicit, and a wrong graph partner is rejected even in the one-variable case

agreement-indexed finite support transports every currently proved compiler goal constructor through the two actual clause copiers under one explicit runtime alpha graph: ordered nested goals, hidden failed-branch outputs, empty ambiguity-tail outputs, type-check carry templates, and exact runtime cut barriers are preserved; the clause-level theorem is explicitly conditional on a GoalsAgreeSupported certificate over the complete clause support and does not claim that bare LocalClauseAgrees manufactures hidden-field support

the freshened-head PASS is conditional on LocalClauseAgrees, whose TermAgrees relation covers proper lists and the partial-value encoding but has no improper-list constructor; PatternTermAgrees models dotted pattern cells separately, so dotted clause-head transport into the runtime alpha relation and its observation bridge remain open rather than silently included

producing the agreement-indexed body-support certificate for every compiler-generated local clause remains open, as do compiler/executable agreement constructors for catch, once, transaction, dynamic calls, eval, space matching, and world actions; the proved supported fragment already covers cut tagging, nested findall, ambiguity, conditionals, and type-check carry without laundering hidden fields

the database projection, typed-scope erasure, exact freshened head payload, occurrence-level alpha foundation, and support-indexed body-goal alpha transport are proved, but unconditional production of the body support certificate, the live-support alpha environment for the abstract fresh frontier, prepared-cursor to executable-alternative ownership, bounded two-independent-steps to one atomic call_resolve macro, substitutions/observations/effects, and ordinary non-collection step correspondence remain open

fine-grained findall has exact arbitrary-prefix parsing, closed-run equivalence, and sealed collapse for arbitrary nesting; the database/scope store bridge and single-clause alpha freshening are proved, while residual-template copying, ordinary state-step correspondence, remaining typed nested frames, executable step function, and CLI migration remain open
bytes-to-AST-to-program-to-exact-trace theorem open
